note: HAIrdwood's ladder record. One row per rung, chronological, written the day the rung is placed — before tip-off — so the record is timestamped in the repo rather than asserted after the fact. Empty means the ladder has not started; the board then shows rung one off the seed.

fields.date: slate date, YYYY-MM-DD (the basketball day rolls at 6am ET)
fields.line: the half-point line the bet was written at
fields.p: our probability that the line was cleared, at publish time
fields.score: the HAIrdwood grade the pick carried
fields.stake: what was risked, if it differed from the replayed stake
fields.status: open | won | lost | void  (void = did not play: stake returned, same rung re-runs)
fields.published: ISO timestamp the rung was committed
fields.firstTip: ISO timestamp of the slate's first tip
